Mobile boat mechanics in St. Petersburg, Gulfport and the Pinellas beaches, FL

St. Petersburg is the sailing and cruising capital of the bay: the Municipal Marina, the Harborage, Maximo Marina, Gulfport Marina, Tierra Verde, and the canals of Shore Acres, Snell Isle, and Coquina Key. Diesel, inboard, and electrical specialists in the network live here.

Waters
  • Tampa Bay and the downtown waterfront
  • Boca Ciega Bay and the beaches
  • Fort De Soto and Egmont Key
  • Pass-a-Grille and John's Pass
Ramps and marinas
  • Demens Landing (downtown)
  • Maximo Park (Pinellas Point)
  • Fort De Soto Park (24 lanes, park fee)
  • Gulfport Marina
  • War Veterans' Memorial Park (Bay Pines)
  • Crisp Park
Boats we see

Sailboats and trawlers in the marinas, express cruisers, offshore and bay center consoles, flats boats in the south county.

What breaks in St. Petersburg

  • Diesel and inboard service backlogs at the yards
  • Storm-damaged boats still being brought back after Helene and Milton
  • Electrical and systems work on live-aboards and cruisers

Questions we get

Do you work at the Municipal Marina and the Harborage?

Yes, with insurance certificates on file where required.

Can you do a pre-purchase mechanical inspection?

Yes. It is one of the most requested jobs downtown, especially on sailboat diesels.
